method: Fresh browser context per sample. firstRenderedAtMs is navigation-origin time after the first geometry-containing whole frame has been submitted; firstRenderedMs/allLoadedMs include the manifest request. These are CPU/browser submission markers, not GPU/display-completion timestamps. Existing runtime.firstUsableMs is the earlier mount-only marker and is not reported as first visible content.

runtime.byteMetric: CPU geometry arrays and manifest residentBytes/encoded bytes estimates; not measured GPU memory
